notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi impersonating Chrome) - full site accessible on every request, no blocks; robots.txt (https://www.eq3.com/robots.txt) has only account/cart/checkout Disallows under User-agent: *, no Claude UA named, no full-site Disallow. TREE: union of homepage __NEXT_DATA__ top nav categories (Best Sellers, Living, Dining, Bedroom, Office, Accessories, Brands/eq3plus, Inspiration, Gifts, Sale) and the full /sitemap.xml category listing (193 /ca/en/category/* URLs). QTY: each candidate leaf fetched individually; exact product count read from the page's own __NEXT_DATA__ JSON at props.pageProps.dehydratedState.queries[2].state.data.pages[0].data.count, cross-checked against the rendered <h1> and product list to confirm the page actually matches the requested slug (this site silently falls back to a stale/parent/sitewide count+product-list on a dead productline slug - caught and excluded several: eq3plus/marimekko/{bath,bedding,kitchen-textiles,accent-pillows} all fall back to a generic 'Brands' page count=205 (Marimekko has been delisted, no longer present in the live subcategory/brand list); rugs/area-rugs/{hallway-runners,rounds-rugs} fall back to the parent Rugs page (h1='Rugs', count=87, identical to /rugs itself) - excluded as non-existent, especially since the 4 valid size subcategories + Others already sum exactly to 87 (21+26+26+11+3); outdoor/accents/{outdoor-rugs,outdoor-accessories} return empty h1/title with an unrelated count=1060 and unrelated furniture product lists - excluded; office/desk-accessories/organization and office/desk-accessories/office-accessories both return the same 4 ergonomic-chair-accessory products (headrests, footrest) despite the 'organization' slug - excluded, not genuine storage; eq3plus/herman-miller/office and eq3plus/humanscale/desk-accessories both fall back to an unrelated 205-item lighting product list - excluded. EXCLUDED (Textile/Storage boundary, neither): all Beds/Mattresses/Seating/Tables/Dining/Office-desk/Outdoor-furniture branches (Furniture); all Lighting branches and lighting brand pages (pablo-designs, Tala/Upton bulbs); accessories/accents/{candles-holders,clocks,decoration,frames--pictures,mirrors,sculptures-wall-art,vases-plant-pots} (Decorative Home Accessories/Wall Decor); accessories/dining/{dinnerware,flatware,glassware,kitchen-accessories,serving-trays} (Kitchen & Dining); accessories/barware/* (bar furniture/serveware, wine racks not a listed storage type); accessories/accents/bathroom-accessories (11 items but a mixed bag of mirror/knob/teak-stool/shower-curtain/bathmat/storage-container with no clean textile-only or storage-only count obtainable - skipped rather than fabricate a subset count); living/entryway/shelves-hooks (3 items: art ledges, open shelf, wood knob - decorative entryway pieces, not genuine storage); bedroom/beds/storage-beds (a bed model, explicitly under the Beds/Furniture subcategory not the Storage subcategory); Gifts branch entirely (gift/collection landing pages per rule). AMBIGUOUS ITEMS INCLUDED AS STORAGE (confidence MEDIUM, flagged): bedroom/storage/{chests,dressers,nightstands} and living/media--storage/{Bookcases,media-units,sideboards-and-credenzas} are furniture-grade case goods (branded lines e.g. Monarch, Marcel, Tambour, Plank) but EQ3's own primary navigation places them under a subcategory explicitly named 'Storage' / 'Media & Storage' (sibling to, not part of, any 'Furniture' label) - included per storage.md Sec17/21 explicit-site-categorization override, each flagged for review given the furniture/storage boundary. office/storage/filing-cabinets included as Storage (site's own productLine label) though its actual contents are desk pedestals + one shelf + one office sideboard rather than literal filing cabinets - qty taken as displayed. accessories/accents/organization (14) included as Storage though ~3 of the 14 listed products are decorative bowls/a platform plate rather than storage items - qty taken as displayed category total per rule (not manually recounted).
